output.question: Who is IBM's CTO?
output.answer: IBM does not appear to have a company-wide Chief Technology Officer. IBM's official senior leadership page lists 22 executives, and none of them holds a CTO title. The closest role at the top is Dr. Jay M. Gambetta, Director of IBM Research. CTO titles at IBM belong to particular units or practices. For example, a March 2026 GovForum post says Sujey Edward joined IBM as 'Chief Technology Officer and Senior Partner,' which is a consulting-level role and not the corporate CTO.

key_facts.fact: No one on IBM's official senior leadership list holds a Chief Technology Officer title.
Dr. Jay M. Gambetta is listed as Director of IBM Research, the senior technology leader in IBM's executive team.
Arvind Krishna is IBM's Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer.
Sujey Edward, previously CTO at Octo, took the role of Chief Technology Officer and Senior Partner at IBM. This is a practice-level role and not on the senior leadership list.

passages.quote: Dr. Jay M. Gambetta: Director of IBM Research
Arvind Krishna: Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
has taken on the role of Chief Technology Officer and Senior Partner at IBM.

caveats: IBM's senior leadership page has no visible date, so the list may be older than the date it was accessed.
IBM has many CTOs at the unit and practice level (for example in IBM Consulting, Software, Infrastructure and Red Hat). Which one counts as 'the CTO' depends on the unit the user means.
Third-party executive directories name other people as IBM CTO (Manish Gupta, Ahmed Farrag). They contradict each other and were not verified, so they are not used here.
The Sujey Edward item is based on a LinkedIn announcement reposted by GovForum, and the date shown on the page may not be the original publication date.
missing_fields: corporate-level IBM CTO name (no such role found on IBM's official leadership page)
